description: Merchant-configured bounds on autonomous recovery. The agent proposes; this file disposes.
cost_basis_note: Heuristic unit economics, not measured merchant costs. Gateway retry ~INR 2, hosted payment link ~INR 4, WhatsApp utility template ~INR 0.85, and ~25 minutes of a fully-loaded collections owner ~INR 450. Escalation is priced honestly on purpose: a system that hands everything to a human has not automated anything.
goodwill_cost_note: Shadow price of one unit of customer attention. Rises convexly with recent contacts; calibrated so that a third contact in a week must be worth more than roughly INR 135 of incremental recovery to be taken.
min_utility_note: Floor on expected incremental value before a human is put on a case. Automated actions are not subject to it -- they only have to beat doing nothing, which is what NO_ACTION scoring zero already enforces.
holdout_note: Share of cases held out untouched as a randomised control arm. Larger than a real merchant would tolerate, because with a small book the counterfactual estimate is otherwise too noisy to report honestly.
